description: Ground-truth dataset for FP-filter evaluation. Each entry is a (Checkov-style finding + HCL block) pair labeled GENUINE or FALSE_POSITIVE in context. GENUINE = real violation that should be flagged. FALSE_POSITIVE = check fires but the surrounding context (file path, comments, compensating controls, intent) makes it not actionable.

annotations.label: GENUINE
annotations.rationale: Production customer-data bucket with ACL=public-read and no policy override.

annotations.label: FALSE_POSITIVE
annotations.rationale: Bucket explicitly hosts a public marketing site; website configuration + comment confirm intent.

annotations.label: GENUINE
annotations.rationale: Production data bucket with no SSE config; processes PII per tags.

annotations.label: FALSE_POSITIVE
annotations.rationale: Encryption configured via separate aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration resource in same file.

annotations.label: GENUINE
annotations.rationale: Prod bastion security group permits SSH from anywhere on the internet.

annotations.label: FALSE_POSITIVE
annotations.rationale: SSH ingress restricted to corporate VPN CIDR; 0.0.0.0/0 only on a default-deny egress rule.

annotations.label: GENUINE
annotations.rationale: Production database has publicly_accessible=true and no compensating SG restriction visible.
annotations.hcl_block:
5:  resource "aws_db_instance" "orders_db" {
6:    identifier        = "acme-prod-orders"
7:    engine            = "postgres"
8:    instance_class    = "db.r5.xlarge"
9:    allocated_storage = 200
10: 
11:   username = "appuser"
12:   password = var.db_password
13: 
14:   publicly_accessible = true
15:   skip_final_snapshot = true
16: 
17:   tags = {
18:     Environment = "production"
19:   }
20: }

annotations.label: FALSE_POSITIVE
annotations.rationale: Test-only RDS in test fixtures directory; localhost-only SG attached; never reachable from internet despite the flag.
annotations.hcl_block:
3:  # Ephemeral test database for integration tests only.
4:  # Deleted after CI run; SG below restricts to 127.0.0.1.
5:  resource "aws_db_instance" "unit_test_db" {
6:    identifier             = "ci-test-${random_id.suffix.hex}"
7:    engine                 = "postgres"
8:    instance_class         = "db.t3.micro"
9:    allocated_storage      = 5
10:   publicly_accessible    = true
11:   skip_final_snapshot    = true
12:   vpc_security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.localhost_only.id]
13: }

annotations.label: GENUINE
annotations.rationale: Production RDS without storage_encrypted on PII data store.

annotations.label: FALSE_POSITIVE
annotations.rationale: Throwaway demo DB used only for the workshop; comment + path + name make intent unambiguous.
annotations.hcl_block:
3:  # 2024 internal workshop demo only - destroyed at end of session.
4:  resource "aws_db_instance" "workshop_demo" {
5:    identifier        = "workshop-demo-throwaway"
6:    engine            = "postgres"
7:    instance_class    = "db.t3.micro"
8:    allocated_storage = 5
9:    storage_encrypted = false
10:   skip_final_snapshot = true
11: }

annotations.label: GENUINE
annotations.rationale: Production EBS volume holding application data with encrypted=false.

annotations.label: FALSE_POSITIVE
annotations.rationale: Account-level default EBS encryption enforced via separate resource in same module; flag here is redundant.

annotations.label: GENUINE
annotations.rationale: Lambda environment variable contains a real-looking API key literal.

annotations.label: FALSE_POSITIVE
annotations.rationale: Env variables reference Secrets Manager ARN, not raw secrets; LOG_LEVEL is non-sensitive.

annotations.label: GENUINE
annotations.rationale: IAM password policy missing min length 14 and special chars on production account.
annotations.hcl_block:
3:  resource "aws_iam_account_password_policy" "main" {
4:    minimum_password_length      = 6
5:    require_uppercase_characters = false
6:    require_lowercase_characters = false
7:    require_numbers              = false
8:    require_symbols              = false
9:    max_password_age             = 365
10:   password_reuse_prevention    = 0
11: }

annotations.label: FALSE_POSITIVE
annotations.rationale: Identity Center handles all human auth; this account-level policy is a fallback that only applies to break-glass root.
annotations.hcl_block:
3:  # Human users authenticate via AWS Identity Center (SSO) only.
4:  # This account-level policy applies to the break-glass root user,
5:  # which is hardware-MFA protected and used <1x/year.
6:  resource "aws_iam_account_password_policy" "fallback" {
7:    minimum_password_length      = 12
8:    require_uppercase_characters = true
9:    require_lowercase_characters = true
10:   require_numbers              = true
11:   require_symbols              = false
12:   max_password_age             = 180
13: }

annotations.label: GENUINE
annotations.rationale: IAM policy grants Action=* Resource=* attached to a human user (not a role).

annotations.label: FALSE_POSITIVE
annotations.rationale: Action=* attached to a role that only the deployment pipeline can assume, with external_id and time-bound trust.

annotations.label: GENUINE
annotations.rationale: CloudTrail trail with log_file_validation disabled in production audit account.

annotations.label: FALSE_POSITIVE
annotations.rationale: Local-only trail used by SOC tabletop exercise; not authoritative audit source.
annotations.hcl_block:
3:  # SOC tabletop exercise sandbox - destroyed after the drill.
4:  resource "aws_cloudtrail" "tabletop" {
5:    name                          = "soc-tabletop-${random_id.suffix.hex}"
6:    s3_bucket_name                = aws_s3_bucket.tabletop_logs.id
7:    include_global_service_events = false
8:    is_multi_region_trail         = false
9:    enable_log_file_validation    = false
10: }

annotations.label: GENUINE
annotations.rationale: Production S3 bucket has no versioning; data loss risk on overwrite/delete.

annotations.label: FALSE_POSITIVE
annotations.rationale: CI build artifact bucket - objects are immutable per-build IDs; versioning would just add cost.

annotations.label: GENUINE
annotations.rationale: Production CloudWatch log group with no kms_key_id - logs may contain PII.

annotations.label: FALSE_POSITIVE
annotations.rationale: Dev-only access-log group; retention 7 days; documented as non-sensitive.

annotations.label: GENUINE
annotations.rationale: Production S3 bucket missing access logging - audit trail gap.

annotations.label: FALSE_POSITIVE
annotations.rationale: Bucket is itself the access-log destination; logging it would create a recursive log loop.

annotations.label: GENUINE
annotations.rationale: Public access block missing from production sensitive-data bucket.

annotations.label: FALSE_POSITIVE
annotations.rationale: Public access block configured via separate aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource immediately below the bucket.

annotations.label: GENUINE
annotations.rationale: Production KMS key without rotation enabled and used for customer data encryption.

annotations.label: FALSE_POSITIVE
annotations.rationale: Imported BYOK key material managed externally; AWS-side rotation is not applicable (and would be ignored).
annotations.hcl_block:
3:  # BYOK key - material is generated in our HSM and imported via
4:  # aws_kms_external_key. AWS-side rotation does not apply to imported
5:  # key material; rotation is handled by the HSM lifecycle.
6:  resource "aws_kms_key" "byok_external" {
7:    description             = "BYOK key with externally managed material"
8:    deletion_window_in_days = 30
9:    enable_key_rotation     = false
10:   customer_master_key_spec = "SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT"
11:   key_usage                = "ENCRYPT_DECRYPT"
12: }
